title: Trader Diary: BTC at $83,226 & My 10x Leverage Dreams
content:
👀 8:00 PM: Spot $83k, I’m already on the 10x chart.
💥 8:15 PM: Price dips 0.3% → My equity hits margin call.
🤦‍♂️ 8:20 PM: “It’s just a dip, I’ll HODL” while the liquidation bot screams.
lesson: Never risk more than you can afford to lose; leverage is a double‑edged sword.
